compatibilityLevels.name: Loaded
compatibilityLevels.evidence: Bundle evaluated and plugin instance constructed.

compatibilityLevels.name: Activated
compatibilityLevels.evidence: onload completed without an uncaught error.

compatibilityLevels.name: Integrated
compatibilityLevels.evidence: Commands, events, views, or processors registered as expected.

compatibilityLevels.name: Workflow verified
compatibilityLevels.evidence: A representative user workflow passed end to end.

capabilities.label: Read vault content
capabilities.description: References APIs that can inspect notes, attachments, or vault metadata.

capabilities.label: Change vault content
capabilities.description: References APIs that can create, edit, move, rename, or delete vault files.

capabilities.label: Use the network
capabilities.description: References browser or Node networking APIs that can contact remote services.

capabilities.label: Access the host filesystem
capabilities.description: References Node filesystem APIs outside Threadleaf's vault abstraction.

capabilities.label: Run host processes
capabilities.description: References Node child-process APIs that can launch programs or shell commands.

capabilities.label: Inspect the host environment
capabilities.description: References environment, operating-system, or home-directory information.

capabilities.label: Read or change the clipboard
capabilities.description: References browser or Electron clipboard APIs.

capabilities.label: Open external destinations
capabilities.description: References APIs that can open a browser, application, or external URL.

capabilities.label: Extend the editor
capabilities.description: References CodeMirror or Obsidian editor-extension APIs.

capabilities.label: Change workspace UI
capabilities.description: References commands, views, settings, ribbon, status, or Markdown render hooks.

capabilities.label: Evaluate dynamic code
capabilities.description: References runtime code evaluation or dynamically selected modules.
